_about: Ratings for elec/voltage_check.py, keyed by LCSC code.
Every entry cites where the number was read. Passive R/C entries are the catalogue attributes of the exact code;
everything else was read from the maker's datasheet (the PDF linked from the same catalogue record) on 2026-10-06.
kind=ic: 'pins' maps pin number -> {n: name, max: abs-max volts or an expression in the IC's own supply names,
min: abs-min, rec: recommended max, drv: supply this pin can drive its net to, gnd: pin that belongs on ground,
internal: node generated by the IC itself (volts), boot: bootstrap pin rated relative to SW, ac_in: AC-coupled input}.
'default' is applied to every pin not listed; any pin on the same net as a named supply is rated 'supply_max'.
Add a part: copy an entry of the same kind, change the numbers, and write the page in 'src'.
kind=conn / switch: 'v' is the working voltage, 'v_peak' (optional) the maker's withstand figure, which is what a transient is judged against.
